theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_pi_fderiv_sum_prod
theorems.statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℝ) (g : ι → Fin r → Eucl k → ℝ) (w v : Eucl k), (∀ i t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g i t) w) → fderiv ℝ (fun x : Eucl k => ∑ i, a i * ∏ t, g i t x) w v = ∑ i, a i * ∑ u, fderiv ℝ (g i u) w v * ∏ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase u, g i t w
